prompt: Some people think that primary school children should not be given homework. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
planAr: المقدمة: أعد صياغة السؤال وبيّن موقفك بوضوح (أوافق إلى حد كبير). الفقرة الأولى: السبب الأول مع مثال (الأطفال متعبون بعد اليوم الدراسي). الفقرة الثانية: السبب الثاني مع مثال (اللعب والأسرة يعلّمان مهارات أخرى)، ثم اذكر باختصار الرأي المخالف. الخاتمة: لخّص موقفك في جملتين.
ideas: Young children are tired after a long school day
Play and sleep help the brain to learn
Homework can make children hate learning
Parents who are busy cannot always help
A little reading at home can build good habits
model:
I largely agree that primary school children should not be given homework. Young children spend most of the day in class, and they need their evenings for rest, play and time with their families.

The first reason is that small children get tired quickly. After six hours of lessons, a seven-year-old cannot concentrate well on more written work. When parents force a child to sit at a table, he often starts to see learning as a punishment. For example, a girl who cries over her maths sheet every night may come to hate the subject, even if she was good at it. Free time, by contrast, gives children the energy they need for the next school day.

Another reason is that play teaches skills which worksheets cannot. When children play football with their neighbours or help to cook dinner, they learn teamwork, patience and responsibility. Reading a story with a parent for fifteen minutes can also do more for a child's language than a page of copied words. These activities are not formal homework, but they help children to grow in a natural way.

However, I accept that a little homework can be useful. It shows parents what their children are learning, and it may help older pupils to form the habit of studying before they start secondary school. For this reason, I would not ban it completely for children aged ten and eleven. Short tasks, such as reading for ten minutes, would be enough.

In conclusion, homework for very young children does more harm than good, because it makes them tired and takes away valuable time for play and family life. Schools should keep it very light in the later primary years and avoid it for the youngest pupils, so that children can enjoy learning instead of fearing it.
notesAr: 1) الموقف واضح من الجملة الأولى (largely agree) ويتكرر في الخاتمة دون نسخ حرفي. 2) كل فقرة رئيسية فيها سبب ثم مثال مرسوم بالذهن (الفتاة وورقة الحساب، كرة القدم مع الجيران). 3) الفقرة الرابعة تعترف بالرأي المخالف بإيجاز، وهذا يدل على تفكير متوازن ويرفع درجة التماسك والمنطق.

prompt: Some young people prefer to live with their parents after they finish their studies. Others think it is better to live alone. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
planAr: المقدمة: اذكر الرأيين وأعلن أنك ستناقشهما. الفقرة الأولى: مزايا العيش مع الأهل (توفير المال، الدعم العائلي) مع مثال. الفقرة الثانية: مزايا العيش وحيدا (الاستقلال، تحمل المسؤولية) مع مثال. ثم عبّر عن رأيك الشخصي في فقرة قصيرة. الخاتمة: لخّص الرأيين وموقفك.
ideas: Living at home saves money on rent and food
Family can give emotional and practical support
Living alone teaches young people to be independent
Some jobs are far from the family home
Privacy and freedom are important for adults

prompt: In many countries, more and more children eat fast food and do very little exercise. What are the causes of this problem and what can be done to solve it?
planAr: المقدمة: عرّف المشكلة باختصار وبيّن أنك ستذكر الأسباب والحلول. الفقرة الأولى: سببان أو ثلاثة مع مثال لكل واحد (الإعلانات، انشغال الأهل، الألعاب الإلكترونية). الفقرة الثانية: حلان أو ثلاثة مع مثال (وجبات صحية في المدارس، رياضة يومية، توعية الأهل). الخاتمة: لخّص الأسباب والحلول.
ideas: Busy parents buy cheap, quick meals
Adverts make fast food look attractive
Children spend hours on phones and games
Schools could serve healthy lunches
Daily sport lessons should be compulsory
Parents can cook with their children

prompt: More and more people now work from home instead of going to an office. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
planAr: المقدمة: أعد صياغة السؤال وحدد رأيك (المزايا أكبر). الفقرة الأولى: المزايا مع مثال (توفير الوقت والمال، المرونة). الفقرة الثانية: العيوب مع مثال (الوحدة، صعوبة الفصل بين العمل والحياة)، ثم اذكر كيف يمكن تقليلها. الخاتمة: لخّص الميزان وأكد رأيك.
ideas: Workers save time and money on travel
Flexible hours suit parents and people with health problems
Companies can rent smaller offices
Some workers feel lonely at home
It is hard to switch off after work
New staff learn faster in an office
model:
In my opinion, the advantages of working from home are greater than the disadvantages, although the situation is not perfect for everyone.

The main advantage is the time and money that workers save. Many employees spend two hours a day on crowded buses or in traffic, and they also pay for fuel or tickets. A man who works from his living room can start earlier, finish on time and use the saved hours to rest or to be with his children. Companies benefit as well, because they can rent smaller offices and pay lower bills. This is why several large firms now allow their staff to work at home two or three days a week.

Another benefit is flexibility. People with young children or health problems can arrange their day around their needs. For example, a mother who is a translator can work while her baby sleeps and send the finished text in the evening. In this way, talented people do not have to leave their jobs.

On the other hand, there are real drawbacks. Workers at home can feel lonely, because they miss the small talk and the support of colleagues. It can also be hard to separate work from private life; some people answer emails late at night and never really switch off. Moreover, young employees learn faster when they sit next to experienced workers and can ask questions at once.

Nevertheless, I believe these problems can be solved. Companies can organise regular meetings in the office, and workers can set fixed hours and choose a quiet corner for their job.

In conclusion, working from home saves time and money and gives people more freedom, so the benefits outweigh the costs, provided that employers and employees manage it carefully.
notesAr: 1) المقدمة تجيب عن السؤال مباشرة (الميزة أكبر) ثم يبقى الموقف ثابتا حتى النهاية. 2) الجمل الرابطة طبيعية (On the other hand, Moreover, Nevertheless) دون عبارات محفوظة مبتذلة. 3) العيوب لم تُهمل: ذُكرت ثم عُولجت بحلول عملية، فتبدو الحجة متوازنة ومقنعة.

prompt: In many cities, a lot of people travel to work by car instead of using buses or trains. Why do you think this happens? Is this a positive or a negative development?
planAr: المقدمة: أعد صياغة الموضوع وأعلن أنك ستجيب عن السؤالين. الفقرة الأولى: أجب عن السؤال الأول (لماذا؟) بسببين مع مثال (راحة السيارة، ضعف المواصلات العامة). الفقرة الثانية: أجب عن السؤال الثاني بوضوح (سلبي في رأيي) مع مثال (ازدحام وتلوث). الخاتمة: لخّص الإجابتين.
ideas: Cars are comfortable and always available
Public transport can be slow, crowded or late
Many workplaces are far from stations
Too many cars cause traffic jams and pollution
Parking costs time and money

prompt: Some people believe that the government should make recycling compulsory by law. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
planAr: المقدمة: أعد صياغة السؤال وبيّن موقفك. الفقرة الأولى: سبب أول مع مثال (القانون يغيّر السلوك بسرعة كما في حزام الأمان). الفقرة الثانية: سبب ثان أو اعتراض مع رد (الغرامات قد تكون ظالمة، لذا نحتاج حاويات سهلة وتوعية). الخاتمة: أكّد موقفك.
ideas: Laws make people change their habits quickly
Recycling saves energy and raw materials
Fines may be unfair for poor families
Clear bins in every street make recycling easy
Schools can teach children to sort rubbish

prompt: Some people think that criminals who commit small crimes should do community work instead of going to prison. Others believe that prison is the best punishment. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
planAr: المقدمة: اذكر الرأيين وأعلن أنك ستناقشهما ثم تعطي رأيك. الفقرة الأولى: حجج مؤيدي السجن (الردع، حماية المجتمع) مع مثال. الفقرة الثانية: حجج مؤيدي الخدمة المجتمعية (التكلفة، تجنب الاحتكاك بالمجرمين الخطرين) مع مثال. فقرة قصيرة لرأيك الشخصي. الخاتمة: لخّص.
ideas: Prison protects society from dangerous people
Fear of prison may stop other people from breaking the law
Prison is expensive for the state
Minor offenders may learn bad habits from serious criminals
Community work helps repair the damage
model:
People disagree about the best way to punish those who commit minor crimes. Some believe that community work is better, while others think that prison is the only real punishment. I will discuss both views before giving my opinion.

Those who support prison argue that it protects society and sends a strong message. A person who steals or damages property and then spends a few weeks behind bars is likely to think twice before doing it again. Other people, seeing this, may also decide not to break the law. In addition, victims often feel that justice has been done when the offender is clearly punished.

However, there are good reasons to prefer community work for small crimes. First, prison is expensive; the state pays for food, guards and buildings, and this money could be spent on schools or hospitals. Second, prison can make things worse. A young man who is sent there for stealing a phone may meet serious criminals and learn bad habits from them. When he comes out, he may have no job and no friends, so he returns to crime. By contrast, a person who must clean parks or help in a care home for two hundred hours repairs some of the damage and stays in contact with his family and employer.

In my opinion, community work is the better choice for first-time offenders who have committed small, non-violent crimes. It is cheaper, it helps the community directly and it gives people a chance to change. However, prison should remain for dangerous people, such as those who attack others, because the public must be kept safe.

In conclusion, although prison has a strong deterrent effect, community work is more useful and fairer for minor offences, and I support it in those cases.
notesAr: 1) المقال يغطي الرأيين بوضوح في فقرتين منفصلتين ثم يعطي الرأي الشخصي في فقرة مستقلة، وهذا ما يطلبه السؤال. 2) الأمثلة محسوسة (شاب سرق هاتفا، تنظيف الحدائق، دار رعاية). 3) الرأي مشروط بدقة (الجرائم الصغيرة وغير العنيفة فقط)، فيبدو ناضجا وغير متطرف.

prompt: Some people think that employees should work only four days a week instead of five. Do you agree or disagree?
planAr: المقدمة: أعد صياغة الفكرة وبيّن موقفك. الفقرة الأولى: سبب أول مع مثال (الراحة ترفع الإنتاجية). الفقرة الثانية: سبب ثان مع مثال (وقت أكثر للأسرة والتعلم)، مع الإشارة إلى مشكلة محتملة وحلها (بعض الوظائف تحتاج دواما كاملا). الخاتمة: أكّد رأيك.
ideas: Rested workers make fewer mistakes
A longer weekend gives time for family and hobbies
Some jobs, such as hospitals, need staff every day
Employees may work longer hours on four days
Companies may save on electricity and office costs

prompt: Many city centres are very noisy and crowded. What problems does this cause for the people who live there, and what can be done about it?
planAr: المقدمة: صف المشكلة باختصار وأعلن بنية المقال. الفقرة الأولى: المشكلات مع مثال (قلة النوم، التوتر، صعوبة التنقل). الفقرة الثانية: الحلول مع مثال (مناطق للمشاة، تحديد ساعات الشاحنات، مساحات خضراء). الخاتمة: لخّص المشكلات وأفضل حل.
ideas: Noise makes it hard to sleep and study
Crowded streets are stressful and unsafe
Air pollution harms health
Pedestrian zones can reduce traffic
More parks give people quiet places
Lorries could deliver only at night or early morning

prompt: Nowadays many people get their news from social media instead of newspapers or television. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
planAr: المقدمة: أعد صياغة السؤال وحدد رأيك (العيوب أكبر قليلا). الفقرة الأولى: المزايا مع مثال (السرعة، المجانية، صور من موقع الحدث). الفقرة الثانية: العيوب مع مثال (الإشاعات، رؤية ما نحب فقط). الخاتمة: لخّص وقدّم نصيحة عملية.
ideas: News arrives within minutes
It is free and easy to use
Ordinary people can post photos from the scene
False stories spread very fast
Apps show us only what we already like
Short headlines hide the full story
model:
Social media has become the main source of news for millions of people. In my view, this trend has both benefits and dangers, but the disadvantages are slightly greater.

The biggest advantage is speed and convenience. When something important happens, such as a storm or a road accident, people can read about it within minutes on their phones. They do not have to wait for the evening bulletin or the next morning's newspaper. Social media is also free and easy to use, so someone who cannot afford a newspaper subscription can still stay informed. In addition, ordinary people can post photos and videos from the scene, which gives us a fuller picture of events.

However, the disadvantages are serious. The main problem is false information. Anyone can post a story without checking the facts, and shocking stories spread faster than careful ones. For example, a false rumour that a local bridge was closed could send thousands of drivers onto other roads and cause a huge traffic jam. Newspapers and television channels, by contrast, usually employ editors who check facts before they publish.

Another problem is that social media shows us only what we like. The apps choose posts that match our interests, so people rarely see other opinions. Over time, this can make them narrow-minded and less willing to listen to others. Moreover, people who read only short headlines may not understand the full story.

To sum up, social media gives fast, free and personal news, but it also spreads rumours and limits our view of the world. In my opinion, the risks are greater, so people should use it together with trusted sources, such as established newspapers, and check any surprising story before sharing it.
notesAr: 1) الإجابة مباشرة: المزايا والعيوب مذكورة والحكم النهائي واضح (العيوب أكبر). 2) المثال (إشاعة إغلاق الجسر) سهل التخيل ويربط السبب بنتيجة ملموسة. 3) الخاتمة تضيف توصية عملية بدل تكرار الكلمات نفسها.
